items.question: Do you write fake reviews for my business?
items.answer: No. We never write, buy, or manufacture reviews. items.question: Can you remove negative reviews or content from search results?

items.question: What is SEO, and why does it matter?
items.answer: Search engine optimization is the practice of improving your site so it ranks higher in organic (unpaid) search results. It matters because organic search is often the highest-intent, most cost-efficient channel for finding new customers over the long run.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside the US?
items.answer: Yes — we work with clients across the US, UK, Canada, Spain, France, and beyond. Our strategies account for local search behavior and, where relevant, multi-region or multi-language SEO.

items.question: Do you handle work in-house, or outsource it?
items.answer: The large majority of work is handled in-house by our team of 45+ certified specialists. For a small number of highly specialized tasks, we partner with carefully vetted external experts.

items.question: Can you support enterprise-level organizations?
items.answer: Absolutely. We work with businesses of every size, and our processes, reporting, and account structure are built to scale to complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.

items.question: How quickly can I expect results?
items.answer: SEO is a long-term channel — most clients see measurable improvement in rankings and organic traffic within 3–6 months, depending on your industry, current site health, and the scope of work.

items.question: How do you measure success?
items.answer: We track organic rankings, traffic, conversion rate, and ultimately ROI — and report on all of it transparently, on a regular cadence you can rely on.

items.question: What's your approach to link building?
items.answer: We earn links through valuable, relevant content and genuine outreach — never black-hat or spammy tactics that put your domain at risk.

items.question: Do you offer any guarantees?
items.answer: We can't guarantee specific rankings — no honest agency can, since search engines don't sell that outcome. We do commit to a transparent process and measurable progress toward your goals.

items.question: How much do your services cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope, industry competitiveness, and your goals. See our Pricing page for starting ranges, or get a tailored proposal after a free consultation.

items.question: Are there long-term contracts?
items.answer: We work month-to-month after an initial 3-month minimum — the time it typically takes for a strategy to start showing measurable traction.

items.question: Can I change my plan later?
items.answer: Yes — most clients start with a smaller scope and expand as results compound. We'll revisit your plan together at any regular strategy call.

items.question: Do you offer a profit-sharing model?
items.answer: For qualifying US-based businesses, yes — ask about our profit-sharing option during your consultation.

items.question: Will I have a dedicated point of contact?
items.answer: Yes — every client is assigned a dedicated account manager and a team of specialists who work as an extension of your in-house team.

items.question: How often will we communicate?
items.answer: Typically a regular strategy call (weekly or bi-weekly depending on your plan), plus transparent reporting and direct access to your team in between.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: Access to your website analytics and search console, a conversation about your goals, and a point of contact on your side — we'll handle the rest.

items.question: Can you also build or redesign our website?
items.answer: Yes — our WordPress Development service builds SEO-first sites designed to rank and convert from day one.
